```{r config, include=FALSE}
# Repository location, separate from DATA_ROOT. Replace with the absolute path
# to your clone (the directory containing shared-R).
REPO_ROOT <- "/path/to/repo"
REPO_ROOT <- normalizePath(REPO_ROOT, mustWork = TRUE)
# Input locations. Set these before knitting.
DATA_ROOT <- "" # project data directory (per-analysis subdirectories)
PANGENOME_DATA <- "" # pangenome data directory (BUSCO summaries etc.)
COLOR_KEY <- "" # strain colour key (ColorScheme.tsv)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
set.seed(0)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = file.path(DATA_ROOT, "Assembly_metric_analysis"))

library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(scales)
library("dplyr")
library(factoextra)
library(tidyr)
source(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "shared-R", "JFMV_2025_Aesthetic.R"))
library(ggrepel)
library(ggbeeswarm)

```

```{r load data length and gap stats}
# Load data
data <- read.table("040326_stats_with_everything.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")

# Import color key
color_key<-read.delim(COLOR_KEY, header = TRUE)
```

```{r add plotting group}
data$Group2<-data$Strain
# Set all 75_CC to "RI"
data$Group2[data$Group == "75_CC"] <- "RI"

# Set all "CC" containing RI_vJax to "RI"
data$Group2[grepl("CC", data$Group2) & grepl("RI_vJax", data$Group)] <- "RI"

# Replace "_" with / in Group2
data$Group2<-gsub("_", "/", data$Group2)

# Filter out GCA_000181195.1 assembly as it does not have a Strain
data<-data[!grepl("GCA_000181195.1", data$Assembly),]

# Add colors to color_key for any Strains missing in the color_key
rbind(
  color_key,
  data.frame(
  Strain="Other",
  Letter=NA,
  hex="#b7893a",
  RGB=NA
  )
)->color_key

# Replace "ref" in Group with "Founder"
data$Group[data$Group == "ref"] <- "Founder"

# Replace "Founder_v1" in Group with "Founder"
data$Group[data$Group == "Founder_v1"] <- "Founder"
# Replace "75_CC" in Group with "RI"
data$Group[data$Group == "75_CC"] <- "RI"
# Replace "none" with "Other"
data$Group[data$Group == "none"] <- "Other"

# for Group=="Other" set Group2 to "Other"
data$Group2[data$Group == "Other"] <- "Other"

# for Group=="extra" set Group2 to "Founder"
data$Group2[data$Group == "extra"] <- "Founder"

# for Group=="Founder_vJax" set Group2 to it's strain
data$Group2[data$Group == "Founder_vJax"] <- data$Strain[data$Group == "Founder_vJax"]

# Correct Group2 "NZO/HILtJ" to "NZO/HlLtJ"
data$Group2[data$Group2 == "NZO/HILtJ"] <- "NZO/HlLtJ"

# Order data$Group2 to make color_key$Strain
data$Group2<-factor(data$Group2, levels = color_key$Strain, ordered = TRUE)

color_values <- setNames(color_key$hex, color_key$Strain)

# replace colors with "red" except for the "RI" and "Other" entries in color_values
color_values[!grepl("RI|Other", names(color_values))] <- "#94509f"

# Add Founder group to color_values
color_values["Founder"] <- "#94509f"

data$Group<-factor(data$Group, levels = c("Founder_vJax", "RI_vJax", "none_vJax", "extra","Other","RI","Founder"), ordered = TRUE)

# calculate mean gap length
data$mean_gap_length <- ifelse(data$total.gap.bp > 0 & data$total.gaps > 0, data$total.gap.bp / data$total.gaps, 0)
```

```{r plot Total length for all, include=TRUE, fig.width=11/3, fig.height=8/3}
ggplot(data, aes(x = Total.length/1000000, y = Group)) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill=Group, color=Group)) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    width = 0.3, 
    color = "black", 
    stroke = 0, 
    size = 0.75, 
    orientation = 'y'
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_values) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_values) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(2300, 3000)) +
  JFMVTheme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x      = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y       = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold", size=12),
    legend.position   = "none") +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "Total Length (Mb)", y = NULL)->p1_all

p1_all
```

```{r define BUSCO import function}
# BUSCO_import
# Read a BUSCO short_summary text file and return a single‑row data frame
# containing run metadata, BUSCO percentages, BUSCO counts, and (if present)
# basic assembly statistics. Missing fields become NA.
#
# path: character(1) – full path to the short_summary file.

BUSCO_import <- function(path) {
  x <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)

  # trim the “Dependencies and versions:” block
  dep <- grep("^Dependencies and versions:", x, fixed = TRUE)
  if (length(dep)) x <- x[seq_len(dep - 1)]

  # helpers
  grab   <- function(pat, txt = x) grep(pat, txt, value = TRUE, perl = TRUE)
  num    <- function(v) if (length(v)) as.numeric(v) else NA_real_
  intval <- function(v) if (length(v)) as.integer(v) else NA_integer_
  size2bp <- function(s) {
    if (!length(s)) return(NA_real_)
    s <- trimws(s)
    if (grepl(" MB$", s, ignore.case = TRUE))
      return(as.numeric(sub(" MB$", "", s, ignore.case = TRUE)) * 1e6)
    if (grepl(" KB$", s, ignore.case = TRUE))
      return(as.numeric(sub(" KB$", "", s, ignore.case = TRUE)) * 1e3)
    as.numeric(s)
  }

  # percentage line
  tl <- gsub("\\s", "", grab("C:[0-9.]+%"))
  C_pct <- num(sub(".*C:([0-9.]+)%.*",     "\\1", tl))
  S_pct <- num(sub(".*\\[S:([0-9.]+)%,.*", "\\1", tl))
  D_pct <- num(sub(".*D:([0-9.]+)%\\].*",  "\\1", tl))
  F_pct <- num(sub(".*F:([0-9.]+)%,.*",    "\\1", tl))
  M_pct <- num(sub(".*M:([0-9.]+)%,.*",    "\\1", tl))
  E_pct <- num(sub(".*E:([0-9.]+)%.*",     "\\1", tl))
  n_busco <- intval(sub(".*n:([0-9]+).*",  "\\1", tl))

  # BUSCO counts
  n_complete   <- intval(sub(".*?\\t([0-9]+)\\t.*", "\\1", grab("Complete BUSCOs \\(C\\)")))
  n_single     <- intval(sub(".*?\\t([0-9]+)\\t.*", "\\1", grab("Complete and single-copy")))
  n_duplicated <- intval(sub(".*?\\t([0-9]+)\\t.*", "\\1", grab("Complete and duplicated")))
  n_fragmented <- intval(sub(".*?\\t([0-9]+)\\t.*", "\\1", grab("Fragmented BUSCOs")))
  n_missing    <- intval(sub(".*?\\t([0-9]+)\\t.*", "\\1", grab("Missing BUSCOs")))
  n_total      <- intval(sub(".*?\\t([0-9]+)\\t.*", "\\1", grab("Total BUSCO groups")))

  # assembly stats (optional)
  n_scaffolds <- intval(sub(".*?\\t([0-9]+)\\t.*", "\\1", grab("Number of scaffolds")))
  n_contigs   <- intval(sub(".*?\\t([0-9]+)\\t.*", "\\1", grab("Number of contigs")))
  total_len   <- num   (sub(".*?\\t([0-9]+)\\t.*", "\\1", grab("Total length")))
  percent_gaps<- num   (sub(".*?\\t([0-9.]+)\\s*%?.*", "\\1", grab("Percent gaps")))
  scaffold_N50_bp <- size2bp(sub(".*?\\t([0-9.]+\\s*[MK]B?).*", "\\1", grab("Scaffold N50")))
  contig_N50_bp   <- size2bp(sub(".*?\\t([0-9.]+\\s*[MK]B?).*", "\\1", grab("Contig[s]? N50")))

  # metadata
  busco_version <- sub(".*version is: ([0-9.]+).*",     "\\1", grab("^# BUSCO version"))
  lineage       <- sub(".*dataset is: ([^(]+).*",       "\\1", grab("^# The lineage dataset"))
  mode          <- sub(".*mode: ([^ ]+).*",             "\\1", grab("^# BUSCO was run in mode"))
  predictor     <- sub(".*Gene predictor used: (.+)$",  "\\1", grab("^# Gene predictor"))
  asm_path      <- sub(".*for file (.+)$",              "\\1", grab("^# Summarized benchmarking"))
  assembly_file <- basename(asm_path)

  # result
  data.frame(
    summary_path = path,
    assembly_file,
    busco_version,
    lineage,
    mode,
    predictor,
    C_pct, S_pct, D_pct, F_pct, M_pct, E_pct,
    n_busco,
    n_complete, n_single, n_duplicated,
    n_fragmented, n_missing, n_total,
    n_scaffolds, n_contigs,
    total_length_bp = total_len,
    percent_gaps,
    scaffold_N50_bp, contig_N50_bp,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

```

```{r import BUSCO data}
# Define paths
## Make like of v1 founder assemblies. All files in a provided directory ending with "_busco.txt"

BUSCO_v1_files <- list.files(
  path = file.path(PANGENOME_DATA, "BUSCO analysis (mouse assemblies)/"),
  pattern = "_busco.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

## Make list of RI assemblies. All files in a provided directory ending with "_busco.txt"
BUSCO_RI_files <- list.files(
  path = file.path(PANGENOME_DATA, "BUSCO analysis (mouse assemblies)/75_CC/"),
  pattern = "_busco.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

## Make list of Other assemblies. All files in a provided directory ending with "_busco.txt"
BUSCO_Other_files <- list.files(
  path = file.path(PANGENOME_DATA, "BUSCO analysis (mouse assemblies)/11_final_assemblies/"),
  pattern = "_busco.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

## Make list of nonevJAX assemblies. All files in a provided directory ending with "_busco.txt"
# BUSCO_nonevJAX_files <- list.files(
#   path = file.path(PANGENOME_DATA, "BUSCO analysis (mouse assemblies)/extra potential max graph assemblies/"),
#   pattern = "_busco.txt$",
#   full.names = TRUE
# )

# combine all files into a single list
BUSCO_files <- c(BUSCO_v1_files, BUSCO_RI_files, BUSCO_Other_files)

# Import BUSCO data
BUSCO_data <- lapply(BUSCO_files, BUSCO_import) %>% bind_rows()

# remove first column
BUSCO_data <- BUSCO_data[, -1]

BUSCO_data$assembly_file
```
